'''Bron Kand'lar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who worked as an intelligence operative for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Kand'lar worked for [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] and when she was 22 years old, traveled to [[Bilbringi Shipyards]], where she investigated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] research into [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] technology. While she was there, she learned that four of her Bothan clan-brothers had been killed by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].
